title: Answer Context Source Correction QA
principle: Answer audit should lead to a safe correction path, not only passive inspection.
public_repo_rule: Correction actions store only local metadata and source state. They never store raw prompts, raw responses, provider secrets or paid-route approvals in the public frontend.

scenarios.expected: A receipt-focused memory source exposes review, edit, disable and clear-focus actions from the Memory panel.
A receipt-focused knowledge source exposes review, disable-source and clear-focus actions from the Knowledge panel.
Correction disables memory items, knowledge documents or collections for future chat context instead of deleting user content by default.
Users can clear selected-answer source focus and remove panel highlights without deleting receipts or source data.
